stages.full: only after improvement without omission/length/abstention exchange

methods.name: greedy
methods.cutoff: reference arm; always retain

methods.name: beam
methods.cutoff: retain as length-matched control

methods.name: temperature_length_controls
methods.cutoff: retain as explanatory controls

methods.name: self_consistency
methods.cutoff: T3 only if T2 changes decisions and coverage is matched

methods.name: calibrated_abstention
methods.cutoff: report risk-coverage curve; never compare at unmatched coverage

methods.name: VCD
methods.cutoff: VQA-RAD OE T2 passed with 32/32 method-off token identity and functional activation; T3 remains unauthorized pending blinded paired clinical-claim evaluation

methods.name: ICD
methods.cutoff: Apache-2.0 official source pinned; official-formula cross-model port implemented, pending per-backbone T1 method-off identity and T2 activation on the frozen OmniMedVQA smoke manifest

methods.name: DoLa
methods.cutoff: admissible via the official repository's Apache-2.0 Transformers subtree containing the released DoLa generation implementation; root-level unlicensed wrapper code is not copied or used as the paper implementation

methods.name: OPERA
methods.cutoff: VQA-RAD OE T2 passed; T3 remains unauthorized pending blinded clinical claims and a beam/length-matched comparison

methods.name: M3ID
methods.cutoff: not_admissible; local reimplementation is diagnostic only

methods.name: PAI
methods.cutoff: VQA-RAD OE T2 passed including intervention activation; T3 remains unauthorized pending blinded clinical claims and no-intervention control

methods.name: AvisC
methods.cutoff: official LLaVA path retained; cross-model image-proxy implementation is separately reported as AvisC_proxy and is not paper-native

methods.name: DAMRO
methods.cutoff: not_admissible; local reimplementation is diagnostic only because no official method code is released

methods.name: SECOND
methods.cutoff: not_admissible until root project license and 32-token identity are certified

methods.name: VTI
methods.cutoff: not_admissible until the official repository provides an explicit license; medical direction fitting would also require a train-only demo contract

methods.name: VISTA
methods.cutoff: LLaVA-Med VQA-RAD OE method-off passes 32/32 generated-token identity at the unified 256-token budget; VSV-only and SLA-only each change 5/32 sequences and combined changes 3/32, with all arms response-qualified. T3 remains unauthorized pending the frozen blinded clinical review and no-exchange controls

methods.name: VHR
methods.cutoff: T0 source/license/entry passed and source is locally pinned; not_admissible for the current medical common-protocol matrix because official VHR targets HF LlamaSdpaAttention/Transformers 4.45 while the certified LLaVA-Med backend is custom Mistral/4.36. No Mistral semantic port may be reported as official VHR

methods.name: AGLA
methods.cutoff: not_admissible: official repository has no root method-code license

methods.name: AGLA_cleanroom
methods.implementation: paper-disclosed BLIP-ITM GradCAM prompt match plus AGLA logit assembly for all native backbones
methods.cutoff: report as clean-room AGLA reproduction, not execution of the unlicensed official repository; requires T1/T2 per backbone

methods.name: AvisC_proxy
methods.implementation: clean-room image-space blind-region proxy for all native backbones
methods.cutoff: diagnostic cross-model arm; never label as paper-native AvisC

methods.name: ClearSight
methods.cutoff: not_admissible: only the embedded LLaVA subtree has a license; no root license covers ClearSight method code

methods.name: ClearSight_proxy
methods.implementation: clean-room VAF equation plus image-space proxy for all native backbones
methods.cutoff: diagnostic cross-model arm; exact attention hook only where backend exposes compatible tensors

methods.name: MedVR
methods.cutoff: not_admissible for paper-native efficacy: the official release contains training code but no released MedVR checkpoint or tool-enabled evaluation entry point; it is not a model-agnostic common-protocol decoder

methods.name: RULE
methods.cutoff: not_admissible for paper-native efficacy without released/local preference checkpoint and validated evaluator

methods.name: MMed-RAG
methods.cutoff: not_admissible for paper-native inference: release lacks complete inference checkpoint/path

methods.name: shared_medical_rag
methods.cutoff: T3 only after one frozen query/top-k/context schema is shared across model adapters

methods.name: FactMM-RAG
methods.cutoff: not_admissible until the official retriever checkpoint and split-complete MIMIC/CheXpert data are locally audited

methods.name: MR-RAG
methods.cutoff: not_admissible unless official code, data and checkpoint become complete
